satellites.title: How Many Times to Think?
satellites.evidence: Analects 5.20 tells of Ji Wenzi thinking three times before acting; Confucius responds that twice is enough. Deliberation has limits as well as value.

satellites.title: Volition, a Universal Factor
satellites.evidence: In the Abhidharmakośa 思 renders cetanā, volition. It is one of ten factors present in every moment of mind: 受想思觸欲，慧念與作意，勝解三摩地，遍於一切心 — the same verse holds 慧, 念 and 三摩地, three more stars of Knowing.
satellites.caveat: Classical 思 is thinking or longing; cetanā as volition is a technical sense.
